newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle steady to lower - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle steady to lower - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested with a weak undertone noted. Trade slow to moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest light to moderate.
Offerings light. Steers: Select and Choice 2-4 no sales
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125-1200 lbs few 74.25-75.00
Carcass Basis: Slaughter steers & heifers weak to 1.00 lower versus Monday's close.
Steers: Select and Choice 2-4 1175-1300 lbs 117.00-118.00 few to 119.00
